viewNote: Default keeps every active model. Chatgpt keeps only ChatGPT.
rangeNote: This preview uses one daily run, so changing the dates or models keeps the same scores.
pickDays: Click a start day, then an end day.
tagOrNote: A prompt matches if it has any selected tag.
tagAndNote: A prompt matches only if it has every selected tag.
upgradeTitle: This model is not in the preview
upgradeBody: OpenAI Luna and Qwen API stay locked here. Choose one of the models already in this workspace.
pickModel: Select at least one model. With none selected, the list still shows the same daily run.
modelNote: Model choice does not change scores in this preview. There is only one daily run.
pickTopic: Select at least one topic, or the list stays empty.
mentionNote: Mentioned means at least one tracked brand appears in the answer.
metricNumber: Enter a number. Leave a box empty if you do not want that limit.
metricNote: Rows outside these numbers are hidden. Empty boxes are ignored.
noBrandMatch: No brand matches that search. Try another name.
brandNote: Scores stay on {brand}. Unchecked brands are hidden from Mentions.
brandExists: That brand is already in the list.
brandAddedBody: {name} is now in the brand list. Check it to show its mentions.
addBrandBody: Add a competitor so its mentions can appear in the table. This preview does not look the brand up online.
libraryNote: {total} prompts are in All prompts. {tracked} run each day. {waiting} are saved here and are not run yet. This plan tracks {limit}. Open Suggested to track more.
noTopics: No topics to show. Turn empty topics back on, or create one.
suggestedTopicsNote: Topic ideas stay as placeholders in this preview.
topicHelp: Use a short name people on your team will recognize. Prompts are filed under it.
topicExistsBody: Choose the existing topic from the list, or use a different name.
topicCreatedBody: {name} is selected. Add a prompt or suggest some to fill it.
deleteTopicBody: {name} has {count} prompts. Delete is blocked while any prompt is still in the topic. Archive or delete those prompts first.
deleteTopicEmpty: Delete {name}? It has no prompts, so this only removes the topic.
topicHasPrompts: This topic still has prompts. Archive or delete them, then delete the topic.
topicDeletedBody: The empty topic is gone from the list.
exportEmptyBody: The current list is empty. Clear the search or pick a topic that has prompts.
exportedBody: {count} prompts saved from the current list.
volumeTip: The estimated volume for prompts with this or similar intents relative to your industry.
learnMoreBody: These bars are sample estimates. They do not come from live search data.
daysAgo: {count, plural, =0 {Today} =1 {1 day ago} other {# days ago}}
creator: Content creator
limitFull: You are tracking {max} of {max} prompts. Archive one before adding or tracking another.
limitMissingTitle: No plan is saved on this account
limitMissingBody: The allowance is 0, so these prompts cannot be tracked yet. Lite tracks 15, Standard 100, Premium 400, and Enterprise 1,000. Save the plan, then track them again.
slots: {used} of {max} prompts are tracked. You can add {room} more.
addBody: Create a competitive prompt without mentioning your own brand. Every line will be a separate prompt.
chooseTopic: Choose a topic. The prompt is filed under that topic.
writeFirst: Write a prompt first. Each line becomes its own prompt.
lineBrand: Remove {brand} from this line: “{line}”. Competitive prompts should not mention your brand.
bulkHint: Make sure your CSV follows the required format, or
drop: Drag and drop your file here, or
fileOverLimit: This file has {count} prompts and only {room} slots are free. Remove rows or archive prompts until you are under {max}.
moreErrors: {count} more rows need a fix before they can be added.
csvOnly: This preview reads CSV or TXT files. Export the sheet as CSV, then upload it again.
importBody: This can be an export from Google Search Console or any third-party SEO tool. Put the keywords in the first column. Each keyword becomes a suggested prompt you can track or reject.
keywordEmpty: The file has no keywords. Put one keyword in the first column of each row.
importedBody: {count} suggested prompts were added. Track the ones you want to measure.
rowEmpty: Row {line} has no prompt. Add text in the prompt column.
rowBrand: Row {line} mentions {brand}. Remove your brand name from that prompt.
rowTopic: Row {line} uses the topic “{topic}”, which does not exist. Create that topic first, or use a topic from the list.
addedBody: {count} prompts are now active. Scores appear after the next daily run. This preview leaves them blank until then.
addedPartial: Added {added}. {left} were left out because the {max} prompt limit is full. Archive a prompt, then add the rest.
needTopicBody: Suggestions are filed under one topic. Choose it in the left column, then generate again.
suggestCapBody: You already have 60 suggestions. Track or reject some before generating more.
suggestAddedBody: {count} new prompts are in Suggested. Track the ones you want to measure.
archivedBody: {count} prompts moved to Archived. Reactivate them whenever you want them measured again.
archivedOne: The prompt is in Archived. Open that tab to bring it back.
deletedBody: {count} prompts were removed from this preview.
deletedOne: That prompt was removed from the list.
reactivatedPartial: Reactivated {moved}. {left} stayed archived because you are already tracking {max} prompts.
trackedPartial: Tracked {moved}. {left} stayed in the list because the {max} prompt limit is full.
archiveBody: Archive {count} prompts in this list? You can restore them from the Archived tab.
deleteBody: Delete {count} archived prompts? This preview removes them from the list.
reactivateBody: Move {count} prompts back to Active. This stops if you would pass {max} tracked prompts.
runsTip: Active prompts are checked once a day.
noSearchBody: Clear the search or try a different word.
noFilterBody: Reset filters to see the full list for this topic.
emptySuggestBody: Start by suggesting prompts for this topic. Then track the ones you want to measure.
emptyActiveTitle: No active prompts in this topic
emptyActiveBody: Add a prompt, or open Suggested and track the ones you want to measure.
emptySavedTitle: No prompts were saved for this brand
emptySavedBody: Select one topic on the left, not All topics. Then choose Generate prompts. The suggested prompts stay on this screen. Track the ones you want, and they appear on the Active list.
emptyWaitingTitle: {count, plural, one {# suggested prompt is ready} other {# suggested prompts are ready}}
emptyWaitingBody: Open Suggested and read them on this screen. Track the ones you want to measure. This Active list stays empty until you do that.
emptyArchivedBody: Archived prompts show up in this tab. Use Archive on an active prompt to move it here.
winTourBody: Win rate is the share of answers where you're ranked first.
winTourTail: to add it to this table.
overviewBody: {count} active prompts are being measured for {brand}. Open All prompts to edit that list.
discoverCapBody: Reject or activate some suggestions before generating more.
discoverAddedBody: {count} prompts were added to Discovery. Activate the ones you want to track.
discoveryEmptyBody: Generate more prompts to see new suggestions.
onTargetTip: Branding and intent are within 5 points of the targets.
offTargetTip: A share is more than 5 points away from its target. Open Adjust targets to change the mix.
emptyTopicTip: This topic has no suggestions yet. Generate prompts to fill the targets.
noCountryBody: Coverage appears here as prompts are added.
overviewAllBody: This overview includes every model for the selected topic.
distributionLead: Branding split, intent mix, personas, and prompt set size
watchVideoTitle: No walkthrough video in this preview
watchVideoBody: This preview does not include the video. Use the sliders to set branding, intent, personas, and how many prompts to write.
brandingSum: Non-branded and branded always add up to 100%. Moving one slider updates the other.
intentHelp: Where buyers are in their journey.
intentSum: Informational, commercial, and transactional always add up to 100%. Moving one slider updates the others.
personasHelp: Each prompt is tagged with the persona it fits best.
personasKeep: Keep at least one persona, or turn personas off.
personasOff: Personas are off. New prompts will not be tagged with a persona.
setSizeHelp: How many prompts we write for each topic. Bigger sets take longer to generate.
extraContextHelp: We follow this when writing your prompts. It overrides the settings above.
extraContextPlaceholder: e.g. We sell to mid-market B2B teams in Europe, focus on migration and pricing questions, skip consumer use cases
editPromptHelp: Branded prompts can mention {brand}. Other prompts should not.
promptSavedBody: The new wording is saved in this preview.
noCurrentTags: No tags yet. Add one below.
tagHint: Click a current tag to remove it. Click an available tag to add it.
tagNeeded: That tag is already on this prompt.
nothingToReview: There are no suggestions in this list. Generate prompts, or clear the search.
discoverAddedContext: {count} prompts were added using your additional context. Activate the ones you want to track.
filtersSavedBody: This preview keeps these filters until you reset them or reload the page.
bulkFailed: {count, plural, one {# prompt was} other {# prompts were}} not changed. {reason}
noTagsYet: No tags yet. Type a name above to create your first tag.
suggestInDiscovery: {count, plural, =0 {No prompts were generated, so this screen stays here. Pick one topic and choose Generate prompts again.} one {# suggested prompt is listed on this screen. Read it, then track it if you want it measured.} other {# suggested prompts are listed on this screen. Read them, then track the ones you want measured.}}
runIntro: {count, plural, one {We will ask # prompt in each AI engine you pick, from the country you pick.} other {We will ask # prompts in each AI engine you pick, from the country you pick.}}
runQuotaNote: Each model in this run uses one prompt check for each prompt. The cap is your plan's daily prompts times the models on your plan: 7 days during the trial, then 30 days each month. A check comes back when that model does not answer.
runNoPrompts: There are no prompts to run. Add or select active prompts first.
runPickCountry: Pick a country to run the prompts from.
runPickEngine: Pick at least one AI engine.
runLockedNote: Models marked Upgrade are not on your plan, and models marked Soon cannot run yet. Pick a model without a mark, or upgrade your plan.
runKeepsGoing: You can close this window. The run keeps going and the answers appear in Recent chats.
runNoResults: The run finished without answers. Try again later or pick other engines.
runResultFailed: This engine did not answer. Your prompt check was returned.
